line: Warm off-white paper, ink stick figures, one red accent; a chibi presenter talks from the bottom-right while each keyword pops on the beat.
line_cn: 米白纸上黑色火柴人，全片只用一种红；右下角墨线主讲人「墨丸」开口说话，关键词一出口，画面同帧动。
source: Style study of a public X post by @CrazyKaomei (https://x.com/CrazyKaomei/status/2116714340908965924) — style learning only, no original footage kept
presenter: 墨丸 Mowan: ink-brush round head, red-cord brush-tip topknot (signature), red 睿 seal on cheek; 3 expressions, wave/point, blink, 5 mouth shapes, boiling lines
